lemmas.primary_translation: to be concerned only with oneself and one's own affairs

definitions.text: bare bry eller konsentrere seg om seg selv og sine egne saker
definitions.translation: to be concerned only with oneself and one's own affairs (lit. to sit, each on one's own grassy mound)

examples.no: partene sitter på hver sin tue og nekter å samarbeide
examples.en: the parties are each on their own little mound and refuse to cooperate
